description: Action vocabulary for toimenpide.toimenpide — built from REAL production data (discovery queries run 2026-06-XX on T's test_database.sqlite). The legacy column is free text, but it follows strong conventions: short Finnish abbreviations + optional details. The agent writes new entries following the same conventions so legacy reports stay consistent.
data_source: GROUP BY toimenpide on test slice (37 distinct values) + Phuc/Tuomas stocktake example

ISTUTUS.convention: IST. <location_code>[/<count or amount>] — location code is appended after the action

variants_seen: marjat pesty ja siemenet siemeniä varastossa-osastolle
MUU.doc: Freeform — agent writes the gardener's words near-verbatim, prefixed with nothing.

stocktake_format.doc: From Tuomas via Phuc: the standard inspection record format. The agent should PARSE this from speech and also GENERATE it when writing menestymista_koskevat_havainnot.
stocktake_format.example: *** 3 kpl, 2-4 m, kukkii, ovat liian tiheässä, yksi huonompi

fields.free_notes: anything else, comma-separated, stays in Finnish

stocktake_format.agent_rule: When a gardener describes condition in speech, compose the record in this exact format: stars first, then count, then size, then status, then notes. Keep the gardener's own words for the notes part.

encoding_warning: Legacy rows contain latin1-mangled characters: '|' = ö, '{' = ä, '}' = å. Example: 'kylv|s' = 'kylvös', 'karpalokentt{' = 'karpalokenttä'. The agent must normalize these when READING. When WRITING, always use proper UTF-8.

inspector_code_mapping.doc: tarkastaja column uses initials that do NOT directly equal kayttajan_tunnus. Mapping discovered so far (needs confirmation from T for the full staff list):
inspector_code_mapping.agent_rule: Store the gardener's initials from their profile (users/{uid}.legacyInspectorCode). If unset, ask once on first write and save.
